buildings.n: De Capucijn / Ter Vere / De Passage

walls.source: Inventaris Onroerend Erfgoed, 'Historische stadskern van Maaseik' (https://id.erfgoed.net/erfgoedobjecten/140051)
walls.note: Maaseik late-medieval wall (rebuilt 1477, repaired 16th c.) with four gates, traced from the Ferraris map (1777). The bastions on the Ferraris sheet's outskirts are 1670s French work and are not traced. Moat all round (marshy ground).

landmarks.y1650: The parish church of 1650 stood on the Markt and was demolished in the 1840s; the present church (1840-45) stands nearby. Position approximate.
landmarks.src: Inventaris Onroerend Erfgoed, 'Historische stadskern van Maaseik' (id.erfgoed.net/erfgoedobjecten/140051)

landmarks.y1650: Building on the Markt that served as council house, cloth hall and guild house (inventory 140051); the present town hall is later.
landmarks.src: Inventaris Onroerend Erfgoed, 'Historische stadskern van Maaseik' (id.erfgoed.net/erfgoedobjecten/140051)

landmarks.y1650: Convent of Saint Agnes inside the walls from 1485.
landmarks.src: Inventaris Onroerend Erfgoed, 'Historische stadskern van Maaseik' (id.erfgoed.net/erfgoedobjecten/140051)

landmarks.y1650: Crosier friary with a stretch of town wall in its garden.
landmarks.src: Inventaris Onroerend Erfgoed, 'Historische stadskern van Maaseik' (id.erfgoed.net/erfgoedobjecten/140051)

landmarks.y1650: Women's abbey founded in the 8th c. at Aldeneik, 1.5 km east; the Romanesque church of Sint-Anna survives.
landmarks.src: Inventaris Onroerend Erfgoed, 'Historische stadskern van Maaseik' (id.erfgoed.net/erfgoedobjecten/140051)
landmarks.special: Van Eyck country: the brothers Van Eyck are traditionally said to come from Maaseik

ruler.name: Prinsbisdom Luik
ruler.sovereign: Prince-bishop Ferdinand of Bavaria (1612-50), then Maximilian Henry of Bavaria (elected 1650); neutral in the Franco-Spanish war (neutrality recognised by Spain only in 1654, see history-check F76)

overworld.note: coordinates are overworld metres: town-local metres (around origin) + centre; 1:1 scale inside radius
